join.title: Join the room
join.subtitle: Type the code you see on the board. No e-mail or password needed.
join.nicknameHint: Use your first name and the initial of your surname (e.g. Mark R.), not your full surname.
join.alreadyInside: I had already joined from another computer
join.newEntry: I'm new, I want to join
join.pinHint: Ask your teacher for a PIN for your name: it works once, for 10 minutes.
join.loggedInWarning: You are logged in as {{name}}: joining the room logs you out of your account on this browser.
join.privacy: We only keep the name you choose and your work: everything is deleted when the room closes (2 hours at most). Conversations go through an AI service.

errors.not_found: Code not found or room closed. Check the letters.
errors.room_locked: The teacher closed the entrance of this room.
errors.nickname_taken: This name is already used in the room. If you had already joined from another computer, ask your teacher for a PIN.
errors.bad_pin: Wrong or expired PIN: ask your teacher for a new one.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts from this network, wait a few minutes.

join.ended: If you were in a room, it has closed and its data was deleted. To join another room, type the new code.

guest.dataNote: Your work is saved for your teacher and deleted when the room closes.
guest.leaveText: To come back you will need a PIN from your teacher. Your work stays saved.
guest.closedText: Time is up or the teacher closed the room. Your data has been deleted.
guest.aiMissing: The AI of this room is not ready yet: tell your teacher.
guest.allDone: Path complete! You can redo a stop or wait for your teacher.

open.title: Quick room
open.subtitle: A temporary room: students join with a code, without signing up. It deletes itself after {{hours}} hours at most.
open.assignmentHint: Students do it with its goals and automatic assessment.
open.how1: Project the code or the QR: students go to /entra.
open.how2: Each picks a name and an avatar, no e-mail.
open.how3: Follow their work live and read the conversations.
open.how4: Download the results or import them into a class: after {{hours}} hours everything is deleted.
open.anonymousNote: You are opening the room without an account: save the management link shown on the next page. To import the results into a class you will need an account.
open.loginNeeded: Log in as a teacher to open a quick room.
open.disabled: Quick rooms are not enabled on this site.
open.modeExisting: Use an assignment of my classes
open.prepareHint: Prepare the activity like an assignment: the characters, topic and goals you fix here are locked for the students, who go straight into the activity. What you leave empty, they choose.

host.subtitle: Project this page: students join with the code.
host.endTitle: End the room and delete everything?
host.endText: Students are logged out and their work deleted. Download the results first if you need them.
host.saveReminder: The room closes in {{time}}: download the results or import them into a class, then everything is deleted.
host.empty: Nobody yet: students show up here as soon as they join.
host.pinHint: Give a PIN so the student can join again from another computer
host.pinText: The student goes to /entra, picks «I had already joined», types their name and this PIN. It works once, for 10 minutes.
host.removeText: The student is logged out and their work deleted.
host.conversationsText: This student's conversations in the room.
host.resultsText: Before the room closes you can save the class's work.
host.importIntoClass: Import into one of my classes
host.fileNote: The .aula file is encrypted: it can only be read by importing it into one of your classes on this site.
host.fileNoteAnonymous: The .aula file is encrypted: you can import it into a class after creating an account.
host.keyNote: To manage the room from another device you need this secret link: do not share it with students.
host.closedText: The room has ended or the link is not valid: its data has been deleted.
host.aiMissing: The chat will not work: no AI model is available for quick rooms. Tell the administrator (Admin → AI → Quick rooms).
host.inviteCopied: Invite link copied: whoever opens it joins without typing the code.
host.loadFailed: The room could not be loaded: check the connection.
host.connectionLost: Connection lost, retrying… What you see may be out of date.

import.title: Import the work into a class
import.roomText: Match each name with a student of the class: their work becomes part of their history. Unmatched names are deleted and the room closes.
import.fileText: Pick the .aula file downloaded from a quick room and match each name with a student of the class.
import.noStudents: This class has no students yet.

admin.title: Quick rooms
admin.hint: Temporary rooms: students join with a code, a nickname and an avatar, without signing up. Everything is deleted when the room closes (2 hours at most).
admin.enabledHint: Teachers and substitutes can open temporary rooms.
admin.allowAnonymousTeachersHint: People without an account can open a room with a secret link.
admin.freeOnlyHint: Guests only use models priced at zero.
admin.limitsHint: Limits apply per student and per room, never per IP address: in a computer lab every computer goes out through the same router. 0 = no limit.
admin.modelsHint: Pick a provider and key dedicated to this use (e.g. free DeepSeek or Gemini Flash). Add the provider with its key above first.
admin.useMain: No model: rooms use the main routing (free models only when that option is on).
admin.noChatModel: Warning: with these settings room students have no chat model. Pick a free model below, set its price to 0 in «Prices», or switch off «Free models only».
admin.ignoredNotFree: Not used: it is not known to be free and «Free models only» is on. Set its price to 0 in «Prices» if it is free.

subtitles.theme: Pick the first activity and its characters: it will be the theme of the lesson.
subtitles.path: Add more stops or take an idea related to the theme. Students do them in order.
subtitles.launch: Choose the characters' language and how long the room lasts. After at most {{hours}} hours everything is deleted.

apps.convinci-tu: Convince a historical character of an idea.
apps.doppia-intervista: Interview two characters together and compare their answers.
apps.personaggio-misterioso: Guess who is hiding behind the answers.
apps.impersona-tu: Play a character and stand up for their ideas.
apps.you-moderate: Moderate a debate between two characters.

wizard.moreOptions: More options: title, instructions, goals, turns
wizard.suggestionsNeedTheme: Pick a character in the first stop and we'll suggest related activities.
wizard.suggestionsError: I can't suggest ideas right now.
wizard.languageHint: It applies to every stop and is locked for students: pick a foreign language to let them practise. The site stays in their language.
wizard.useExisting: Or open the room on an assignment of one of your classes
wizard.suggestionsTitleMystery: Ideas related to your mystery character
